newsitem.title: USA: Converse unit's bankruptcy plan confirmed.
newsitem.headline: Converse unit's bankruptcy plan confirmed.

text.p: Converse Inc said Wednesday that a federal bankruptcy court in New Jersey has confirmed a plan of orderly liquidation for its subsidiary, Aplx One Inc, under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code.
The plan includes a previously announced payment by Converse to the Apex bankruptcy estate of $4 million and reliquishment of Converse's claim against the estate, the athletic footwear maker said.
Converse said the plan also includes a permanent injunction barring Apex's creditors from commencing or continuing any lawsuit against Converse which relates to Apex.
As a a result of the plan, lawsuits seeking monetary damages of about $6.3 million filed against Converse by several Apex creditors will be terminated, it said.
Converse also said it has settled claims against several additional sellers of Apex who were not participants in the trial.
It said the settelments will restult in the cancellation of warrants to buy about 500,000 Converse common shares and cancellation of $1.5 million of other Converse obligations.
The securities were issued by Converse in connection wth its purchase of Apex in June 1995, it said.
